item.text: [{"task_id":"2c737e39","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    background = int(round(params['rule'][0]))","    marker = int(round(params['rule'][1]))","    radius = int(round(params['rule'][2]))","    out = grid.copy()","    if background == marker or radius <= 0:","        return out","    anchors = np.argwhere(grid == marker)","    pixels = np.argwhere(np.logical_and(grid != background, grid != marker))","    if len(anchors) < 2 or len(pixels) == 0:","        return out","    scores = []","    for anchor in anchors:","        distances = np.maximum(np.abs(pixels[:, 0] - anchor[0]), np.abs(pixels[:, 1] - anchor[1]))","        scores.append(int(np.count_nonzero(distances <= radius)))","    source_index = int(np.argmax(np.array(scores)))","    if scores[source_index] == 0:","        return out","    source = anchors[source_index]","    for index in range(len(anchors)):","        if index != source_index:","            target = anchors[index]","            out[int(target[0]), int(target[1])] = background","            for pixel in pixels:","                row = int(pixel[0] + target[0] - source[0])","                col = int(pixel[1] + target[1] - source[1])","                if 0 <= row < grid.shape[0] and 0 <= col < grid.shape[1]:","                    out[row, col] = grid[int(pixel[0]), int(pixel[1])]","    return out"],"shapes":{"rule":[3]},"params":{"rule":[0,5,1]},"rationale":"Identify the gray anchor touching the colored pattern.
